visualReview.scope: Detailed permanent exterior and visible bowl in a static open-roof configuration.
visualReview.notes: All 18 portable and 18 shared final frames inspected, with full-resolution facade and geographic overlay checks. Corrections brought upper seating within its supporting frame, enclosed the hospitality slab and recessed window reveals, and smoothed the inflated ETFE cushions. Mast/backstay connections, cable carriages, pleated storage pod, suspended four-sided screen, clear interface shelf, open ramps and red/grey bowl remain visible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Four canonical shared surfaces use physical UV repeats: concrete, painted metal, PTFE membrane and ETFE film. Clear inner shelf retains local transparent PBR. Current geographic rendering, shared material resolution and unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped field long edges establish the northeast goal direction and central anchor. North-up overlay confirms alignment and the intentional cantilevered roof overhang outside the older building envelope. Event slab and concrete feet use native Y0; 0.102m frame-cap burial is explicitly reviewed. Neighbouring streets and detailed plaza terrain are not baked into this building.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed primary-reference exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: SBP, Tony Hogg Design, government mast dimensions and engineer seismic-retrofit description constrain the 36 outward-leaning 50m masts, 261x220m roof, 100x85m opening, 360 carriages, central storage, eight ramp banks and retained concrete structure. Local member sections, fabric saddles, exact row inventory and colour distribution are reconstructed from primary references. This is a static open-roof exterior, excluding animation, private rooms, sponsor artwork and temporary event equipment; it is not an as-built fabrication model.
